observations: A face fills most of the frame against a flat purple background; tangled orange, yellow, red, and white lines cover the upper head, while the lower face and shoulders are blocked in solid black.
Two wide-open eyes with green irises and heavy black lash marks sit near center; the mouth is open, showing white teeth, with dark surrounding marks that pull the lips back sharply.
A dense scribble layer—black, white, teal, and pink lines—runs across the cheeks and forehead, sitting visibly on top of the yellow-gold base color rather than blending into it.
reading: The face pushes close to the picture edge, leaving little open space around it. Green eyes and bared teeth carry high tension, though whether that reads as rage, fear, or something else stays open. The scribble layer over the gold skin gives the surface a frayed quality—lines that sit on top rather than settle in. The solid black shoulders anchor the figure while the flat purple field holds it at a cool distance.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, title neighbors are #85 and #87 in title-derived order.
